escopo: Dois modelos visuais de carta: personagem em cenário e criatura em ação/evento distinto.
observacao: Cenários são fundos opacos de cartas; overlays terão alfa. Nomes, raridades e eventos são escolhas de conceito visual a avaliar; não definições do motor.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: polished full-art illustration for the Arcanoclisma trading card game, portrait composition with a 63:88 ratio. Create a NEW complete narrative illustration from the attached identity/style reference, not a cutout placed on a background.
Reference image role: identity and style only. Preserve Ciantia's recognizable young adult human face, green eyes, long blonde hair with platinum-white streaks. Replace her stance, gaze, facial expression, clothes and entire setting. Do not reuse the reference composition or conjurador artwork.
Scene: an ancient hanging garden on a mountainside, weathered pale stone terraces and bronze irrigation channels above a blue cloud sea. Moss-green roots curve through arches; distant terraced towers and a narrow suspended aqueduct create three distinct depth planes. A small amber seedling glows among ordinary plants.
Subject and action: Ciantia is kneeling sideways on a garden step in the right-middle of the scene, her body in three-quarter rear view, head turned in a clear left profile and eyes looking down-left at the seedling, an amused attentive half-smile rather than the frontal confident expression in the reference. One hand gently guides a tiny golden energy dragon curled around the irrigation channel; the other steadies a weathered notebook on her knee. Both hands remain anatomically clear. The little dragon actively noses the sprout; its shape stays dragon-like, not fire. Ciantia wears a practical ochre-and-moss traveling cape, dark tailored clothing with a modest purple lining and worn bronze fasteners, not the original coat silhouette.
Composition: medium-wide environmental storytelling, character visibly interacting with this particular place. Foreground leaves and a curved channel lead the eye toward her face and the small dragon; background arches recede into mist. Keep faces and important action in the middle/upper 65 percent, with the bottom quarter carrying quieter garden stones to support editable card text later. No blank text boxes painted into the art.
Style: expressive modern independent comic and contemporary animation; clean varied black ink, flat vibrant colors, bold block shadows, fine halftone and stippling, warm ochre/amber balanced with deep teal and moss. Expressive anime-inspired face. Polished high-resolution illustration, not pixel art, not photorealistic, not a glossy 3D render. Light and magic are graphic inked shapes and stippled glows.
Lighting: warm angled morning sun and cool garden shade, restrained silver-violet reflections in the ambient mist; gentle magic, coherent shadows, readable face and hands.
Cosmetic metadata: raridade=rara, arteAlternativa=false. This is an aesthetic sample; do not invent statistics or rules. Generate only the illustration, with a complete opaque scene background; no card frame, letters, words, symbols of costs, numbers, logo or watermark.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: polished full-art alternative illustration for Arcanoclisma TCG, portrait composition with a 63:88 ratio.
Reference image role: creature identity and graphic art style only. Develop the large translucent blue-violet ENERGY DRAGON seen behind Ciantia into a NEW independent narrative card. Do not include Ciantia, do not copy the dragon's old static silhouette, and do not place the old cutout on a scene.
Specific event and setting: an ancient sky bridge is breaking over a deep cloud chasm while a dimensional fissure opens above its far arch. Bronze bridge fittings and stone fragments hang in midair, suggesting interrupted time. Show the energy dragon making a powerful BANKING LEAP through this rupture, protecting the crossing; two tiny distant travelers give a readable scale and react to the event.
Pose: full dragon in a dramatic asymmetrical three-quarter view, muscular chest twisting, head looking UP-RIGHT toward the fissure with an intensely focused protective expression, one forepaw foreshortened toward the viewer and the other stretched sideways against the falling bridge. Both separate forelimbs and both hind limbs must be anatomically visible, wings in different positions, long tail curling back through the midground arch. This is a bounding, twisting movement, not a frontal stance, ordinary lunge or symmetrical spread-wing pose. Strong silhouette, readable motion arcs, a square-ish noble reptilian head with a short restrained crest and few spikes. Ensure plausible dragon anatomy.
Composition: near paw and broken bridge edge in foreground, entire dragon as the middle-plane focus, distant arch/cloud layers/fissure behind. Create depth through foreshortening, overlaps, block shadows and rim lighting: the dragon seems to advance toward the viewer but stays entirely INSIDE the illustration. Keep face and key anatomy in upper/middle 65 percent; lower quarter can hold quieter clouds and curved stone for the editable template later. No painted text area.
Mandatory legendary/alternative lighting standard: expressive luminous white-gold cores in magical energy, coherent warm golden light from the fissure and blue-violet ambient light from the dragon. Fine iridescent gold/rainbow reflections along illuminated energy edges and bronze, concentrated and clear rather than washing out the face or body. The dragon's body stays BLUE-VIOLET, never rainbow-striped. Energy is translucent inked graphic ribbon/construction, not burning fire. Visible fine graphic texture and stippled glows compatible with a gold/rainbow holographic card finish.
Style: contemporary illustrated adventure comic, expressive varied dark ink outlines, vibrant flat colors and bold block shadows, fine halftone and stippling. Preserve the recognizable energy dragon identity from the reference. Polished, clear, no pixelation, no photorealism or plastic 3D appearance; depth is an illustrated illusion.
Cosmetic metadata: raridade=lendaria, arteAlternativa=true. This is a visual concept, not a mechanical ability definition. Generate only the illustration with its complete opaque scene, no frame, text, typography, numbers, cost symbols, logo or watermark.
